findings.title: Secret in service environment
findings.description: Literal secrets in the compose file are committed to version control and visible to anyone who can read the file or inspect the service. Reference secrets from a secrets manager or an env_file outside version control.
findings.expected: secret from a manager or env_file outside version control
findings.remediation: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Use Docker secrets / Compose secrets or a secrets manager; never bake secrets into images or env files.
